static_traits.name: Chen Bowen
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk with, but has not yet discussed poetic inferiority with them
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: I often feel I am the worst Poet, especially when someone criticizes my work. This not-good-enough feeling started a few months ago when a friend did not like one of my poems.
basic_info.core_demands: Negative feedback and the subsequent sense of self-inadequacy markedly affect my ability to enjoy writing, prompting me to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: A few months ago, a friend explicitly said they did not like one of the client's poems. Since that experience, the client often Anticipates Being rejected or Receiving negative feedback when sharing works, persistently self-labeling 'I am the worst Poet' with not-good-enough feelings, and reporting creative and writing Decreased confidence, writing Impaired motivation, and reduced communication with peers.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough (as a Poet)
My value depends on others' evaluations

special_situations.event: A friend explicitly said they did not like one of the client's poems
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If someone does not like my work, it means I am a failed / not-good-enough Poet
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to improve writing skills and seek others' approval to prove oneself

special_situations.event: Before sharing poems with others, the client Anticipates Being rejected or Receiving negative feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If rejected or negatively reviewed, it proves I have no value and should not keep writing poetry
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids sharing works, reduces communication with other writers
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will hate my poems; They definitely think I am terrible

special_situations.event: After receiving criticism, associates it with long-term negative consequences (creativity and confidence destroyed)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One criticism means I will keep writing poorly, with declining ability hard to Recover
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces or pauses writing to avoid failing and being hit again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My writing is finished; I will never write good poetry again

special_situations.event: Frequently seeking others' approval and affirmation to ease unease
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only with others' approval am I a valuable Poet
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly asking others for evaluations, seeking positive feedback to soothe Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If no one approves, I am not worthy of being called a Poet

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and appreciated by others (as a Poet)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected and negated, worrying I have no value
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated by avoiding sharing
Temporarily easing unease by seeking external approval

object_relations.object_representation: Picky/critical others or readers (such as friends)

positive_force: Having professional literary training (Bachelor's degree in literature)
Has basic social support (a few friends to communicate with)
Proactively trying to improve writing and seeking help (willingness for self-improvement)
negative_force: Excessive reliance on external recognition to determine self-worth
Cognitive distortions like Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking
Anticipating rejection before sharing, causing avoidance behaviors
Generalizing one negative feedback into overall inadequacy, self-labeling

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding sharing poems and seeking feedback
antecedent: When needing to share works with others or Anticipating receiving evaluations
Thinking about friends having disliked my work
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing Being rejected and negated, treating one negative feedback as evidence of self-failure
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible negative evaluation to protect self-esteem, lowering Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship estrangement with peers, reduced feedback, creative drive and Decreased confidence

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic Self-denial thinking (like 'I am the worst poet')
antecedent: When receiving or recalling negative feedback
When creation is blocked or facing criticism
target_behavior.core_reason: Core belief 'I am not good enough', evaluating self-worth extremely and generalizing single criticism
target_behavior.function: Providing a 'certain Interpretation' for setbacks through self-labeling, briefly easing Anxiety from uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Creativity and Decreased confidence, difficulty enjoying writing, with Persistent anxiety and avoidance

antecedent: After being activated by negative thoughts
Anticipating others will reject or negatively review
target_behavior.core_reason: Treating criticism as evidence of persistent inadequacy, fearing failure and setbacks again
target_behavior.function: Avoiding facing possible failure and discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Writing time decreases, output lowers, willingness to write in spare time is impaired
